# Customize Niko's Server Profile

The **Customization** section lets a server administrator tailor how Niko appears in that server. Sign in to the [dashboard](https://niko.sryze.cc/dashboard), select your server, and open **Customization**. The live preview lets you click the avatar, banner, display name, or bio to edit that part of the profile.

## Profile details

- **Display name:** Set a server-specific name up to 32 characters.
- **Bio:** Add a short profile description up to 190 characters.
- **Avatar and banner:** Upload an image (PNG, JPG, GIF, or WebP, up to 8 MB) or use an HTTPS image URL. Uploaded images are applied to Niko's Discord server profile; the URL must resolve to an image. Discord hosts applied profile images.
- **Name font:** Choose Sakura, Jellybean, Modern, Medieval, 8Bit, Vampyre, gg sans (default), or Tempo.
- **Name color style:** Choose Solid, Gradient, Neon, Toon, Pop, or Glow. Gradient uses two colors; other styles use one, except Glow can use one or two.

A server that has not set its own avatar or banner previews Niko's global profile picture and banner and says that it is inheriting them. Saving without uploading or pasting an image keeps the server on Niko's global images, so a server never has to copy them to look right.

Changes in the preview are drafts until you select **Save changes**. The settings apply to the selected server only; customizing Niko in one server does not change its identity in other servers. Discord may reject an update if the bot cannot apply the requested profile change. The dashboard displays an error so you can correct the values or try again.

## Permissions and troubleshooting

You must be signed in with a Discord account that can manage the server, and Niko must be installed there. If an image fails, check that it is a supported image, under the size limit, and that an image URL uses HTTPS and is reachable. If the update is rejected, verify Niko is available and retry later.
